script: Dumbest red cards in football history. Manchester United are hosting Liverpool in the FA Cup quarter-finals, and this game was complete chaos because United go up one-nil, Liverpool score twice before halftime to take the lead, and then Antony equalizes in the 87th minute to force extra time, where Liverpool go ahead again through Harvey Elliott. But the last 10 minutes are the reason Diallo had to watch the end of this game from the locker room. Rashford ties it back up, and then in the 121st minute, a 21-year-old substitute named Amad Diallo picks up the ball on a counter-attack, takes one touch, and slots it into the far corner to make it 4-3 in front of an Old Trafford crowd that completely lost it, even though he had only been on the pitch for about 35 minutes at that point. But in the middle of all that chaos, there was one thing Diallo completely forgot about. Five minutes before his goal, he had been given a yellow card, so when he scored and immediately ripped his shirt off in front of 72,000 fans, the referee pulled out a second yellow, second yellow means a red card, so the man who just scored the most dramatic winner of the entire FA Cup that season got sent off for celebrating, and after the match he straight up admitted he forgot about the first yellow.
